definition: [ חֲלַקָּה ] noun feminine smoothness, flattery , only plural absolute: fine promises, יַחֲנִיף בַּחֲלַקּ֑וֺת Dan 11:32 (perhaps directly from חָלָק , exceptional plural, compare גְּמַלִּים , קְטַנָּה , קְטַנִּים , קְטַנּוֺת ).
